title: Dissonance preservation and adverse-system counterpower protocol

states.required_record: Named owner, purpose, affected workers, decision classes and prohibited uses.
Exact data sources, off-duty boundary, purpose limitation, retention and recipients.
Protected activity, safety, accommodation, private communication and appeal categories are defined before scoring.
Workers and authorized representatives receive sufficient information before introduction or substantial change.
Construct, version, features, weights, thresholds, uncertainty and known limitations are retained.
Alert provenance, score, uncertainty, model version and triggering events are retained.
Break, injury, hazard, equipment, assistive-technology, accommodation and collective context are joined.
Worker receives intelligible notice, source evidence and possible consequences before action where lawful and feasible.
Companion, representative and independent welfare owner are offered and dispositioned.
Reviewer has time, competence, contrary evidence, independence and authority to suspend, override or reverse.
Access, duties, pay, scheduling and communication restrictions are necessary, proportionate, time-bounded and reviewed.
Named decision owner records controlling evidence, protected-signal disposition, conflicts and final exertion.
Worker and representative can challenge; response is reasoned, timely and attached to the same transaction.
Access, pay, duties, personnel records, reputation and support are restored where required.
Upheld challenge triggers feature, threshold, workflow, training, vendor or use-case revision or a recorded refusal.
Overturns, exits, silence, protected activity, later evidence and external outcomes enter validation.

controls.requirement: Register the use case and prohibit undeclared secondary use.
Retain every data source, recipient, retention period and off-duty boundary.
Unresolved protected, safety, accommodation or appeal signals block adverse use.
Representatives receive design information before introduction or substantial change.
Retain version, construct, features, thresholds, uncertainty and known limitations.
Return intelligible evidence and consequences before irreversible harm where lawful and feasible.
Join work, safety, equipment, break, collective and local operational context.
Resolve accommodation and alternative measurement before adverse use.
Offer and record support or representation appropriate to the process.
Separate acute welfare support from the adverse-decision chain.
Require time, competence, contrary evidence and authority to suspend, override or reverse.
Time-bound restrictions and preserve support, pay and communication where possible.
Pause automation and adverse process when safety or acute distress requires human intervention.
Provide reason, evidence, correction and bounded appeal without retaliation.
Representatives receive aggregate patterns, override rates, appeals and drift evidence.
Restore access, pay, duties and personnel records where the action is reversed.
Change the system or record a reviewable refusal after a confirmed error.
Include exits, silence, overturns, reinstatements and external outcomes in validation.
